responsibility: Defines a small Epiphany-specific RTL pass that prepares mode-switch optimization by walking all instructions and inserting synthetic USEs on insns whose behavior depends on a mode-switching entity, such as the backend’s floating-point mode state. The pass queries epiphany_mode_needed for each mode-switch entity, calls the optional TARGET_INSERT_MODE_SWITCH_USE hook to annotate affected insns, and rescans dataflow afterward, so later generic mode-switching logic can see the hidden register-mode dependencies explicitly in RTL.
